title: Don't trust the generator
statement: Expect to discard much of what a generator writes, keep the trace of what was accepted and rejected, and let the gates, not trust in the generator, carry the quality.
example: Of 299 items another model could answer with the passage, only 113 passed the check that it could not answer them without it.
detail: A retrospective on a Grade 5 generation run says the questions were good because the generator was not trusted: items survived only if a model from another family could solve them with the passage and not without it, and large volumes of plausible-looking output were discarded (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0091-g5-question-generation-retrospective-codex-2026-07-09.qmd`). In its non-match tranche, 360 items were written, 299 passed the with-text control and 113 were certified blind. The generator's handoff owes an accepted-and-rejected generation trace (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0067-g5-generator-pilot-intake-and-team-async-2026-06-23.qmd`), and in the AP work generated candidates stay candidate material that bypasses none of the source, format, factuality, answerability, independence or human review gates (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0167-portable-workspace-checkpoint-apush-g5.qmd`).
against: Quality review was not run across every final item of that run (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0091-g5-question-generation-retrospective-codex-2026-07-09.qmd`).

evidence.quote: The questions were good because the generator was not trusted.
- discarding large volumes of plausible-looking output.
None bypasses source identity, current-format, factuality, answerability, independence, or human review gates.
Quality-B was not run across every final item: - used on the small sequence MODIFY pilot; - not run over the final 700 MATCH or final 167 non-match items.
The `certification_yield=0.5` default comes from a historical G5 generation campaign (48.7%, rounded).
the retrospective's own headline is 'the questions were good because the generator was not trusted'
Per-type yield through the binding blind gate: sequence 33/975 (3.4%), hot-text 71/1000 (7.1%), match 83/1171 (7.1%).

The pipeline is COMPLETE and LANDS WITH ZERO ACCEPTED CANDIDATES: three full runs against the Aladdin Part 1 lesson each ended in an honest DISCARD on structural gates after the refine budget (manifests in `runs/`).
